title: La fonction zêta de Riemann prend une infinité de valeurs irrationnelles aux entiers impairs
container-title: Comptes Rendus de l'Académie des Sciences - Series I - Mathematics
note: C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris Sér. I Math. 331(4) (2000), 267-270; arXiv:math/0008051. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1016/S0764-4442(00)01624-4) (2026-11-28). Proves infinitely many odd zeta values are Q-linearly independent via hypergeometric linear forms overcoming lcm(1..n)^s denominator growth.
